about.heading: Your Trusted B2B Partner in Commercial Vehicle Components
about.lead: Since 2001, Samer Automotive has been a leading manufacturer and exporter of high-precision spare parts for commercial vehicles, trucks, and trailers.
about.paragraph1: Acting as the global sales and distribution division of Acar Metal, we combine advanced manufacturing capabilities with seamless international trade. From engineering to post-sales support, we supply premium components to distributors across Europe and worldwide.
about.paragraph2: Our strategy is built on long-term partnerships rather than short-term gains. Every component strictly complies with global quality standards, verified by ISO 9001, TÜV, and ADR certifications.

items.name: Electrical Cables and Plugs
items.title: High-Durability Electrical Cables & Plugs
items.description: Heavy-duty electrical harnesses, spiral cables, and multi-pin plugs designed for reliable signal and power transmission in commercial vehicles.

items.name: Air Couplings and Valves
items.title: Industrial-Grade Air Couplings & Pneumatic Valves
items.description: Precision-engineered pneumatic couplings and control valves built to maintain optimal pressure stability in heavy-duty brake and air suspension systems.

items.name: Fuel Tank Caps and Anti-Theft Systems
items.title: Fuel Tank Caps & Anti-Siphon Security Systems
items.description: Robust fuel tank caps and integrated anti-theft devices designed to prevent fuel loss, tampering, and contamination in commercial fleet tanks.

items.name: Repair Kits
items.title: Complete OEM Repair & Service Kits
items.description: All-in-one maintenance kits containing high-grade seals, gaskets, and hardware for fast, reliable, and cost-effective vehicle servicing.
